# Paid Ahead EFTA Sensitive Analysis

## Job Aid
Effective Date: 2/12/26 DP17-ESC372.v01

## Purpose
Identify paid ahead, EFTA sensitive loans when performing an analysis. Written notice
at least 10 days before the scheduled payment date. Governed by EFTA and RESPA.

## Scope
This procedure applies to the Escrow Analysis Department Associates.

## Procedures

1. Confirm if the loan is signed up for ACH. This can be verified in LAMP, under the ACH Tab
    - If yes continue to the next step
    - If no, the loan is not EFTA sensitive
2. Determine If the analysis will cause a payment increase or decrease from the last payment made.
    - If there is a payment increase, continue to the next step
    - If there is payment decrease, the loan is not EFTA sensitive. Stop here and analyze the loan if no other review is required
3. Review the effective date of the analysis and Next Due Date in SSE
    - If the effective date and next due date are in the same month or within in 1 month continue to the next step
    - If the effect date and due date are 2 months apart the loan is not EFTA sensitive. Stop here and analyze the loan if no other review is required.
4. Verify the ACH type and next draft date, then continue to next step
    - ACH type can be verified in LAMP on the ACH Tab
    - Next Draft date for Monthly ACH can be verified in LAMP on the ACH Tab
5. Confirm if there are 15 days before the next draft for monthly ACH and 13 days for Bi Weekly ACH
    - If there is 15 days or more until the next monthly draft or 13 days for the next bi weekly draft, analyze the account
    - If there are less than 15 days until the next monthly draft or 13 days for the next bi weekly draft, wait until the next draft has been processed and analyze the loan the next business days.
    - Important: If the loan is due for the annual analysis and there are not enough days left in the month to wait for the next draft, complete the analysis and document; Loan is EFTA sensitive but annual analysis is required before month end to comply with RESPA.
